calc#3.title: 减速器传动效率与输出轴功率
calc#3.source: 机械设计课程设计手册（第五版）表2-1 机械传动效率概略值：8级精度齿轮啮合效率0.97、滚动轴承每对0.99
calc#3.script:
eta_gear = 0.97      # 8级精度齿轮啮合效率（滚齿）
eta_bearing = 0.99    # 滚动轴承每对效率（深沟球轴承）
eta_total = eta_gear * eta_bearing
P2 = P1 * eta_total   # P1 由 inputs 注入（输入轴功率 kW）
outputs['eta_total'] = eta_total
outputs['P2'] = P2
outputs['eta_gear'] = eta_gear
outputs['eta_bearing'] = eta_bearing

calc#32.title: 轴危险截面弯矩与抗弯截面系数
calc#32.substitution: F_sum=1176 N；L_in=109 mm；L_out=107 mm；d1=48 mm；d_gear_out=40 mm；b_key=12 mm；m=2 mm；t_key=5 mm
calc#32.source: 机械设计（第十版）第十五章：轴弯矩按简支梁计算；抗弯截面系数 W=πd³/32，键槽按近似公式扣除
calc#32.stale_reason: 依赖项 m 已变更（P_in 由 4 kW 改为 5.5 kW）
calc#32.script:
pi = 3.141592653589793
df1 = d1 - 2.5 * m
M_in = F_sum * L_in / 4
W_in = pi * df1**3 / 32

M_out = F_sum * L_out / 4
W_solid = pi * d_gear_out**3 / 32
W_key = b_key * t_key * (d_gear_out - t_key)**2 / (2 * d_gear_out)
W_out = W_solid - W_key

outputs['df1'] = df1
outputs['M_in'] = M_in
outputs['W_in'] = W_in
outputs['M_out'] = M_out
outputs['W_out'] = W_out
